separate_decisions.calendar_exact_scope_and_endpoint_behavi: G-CAL and a dependent contract revision

record_contracts.linked_rule: linked changed completed_needs_evidence missing conflict and ambiguous_write require an encrypted list and artifact locator unless the state is a pre-link proposal
record_contracts.text_rule: no title body due phrase reminder-time value URL raw identifier or generated explanation
no intended readable value request response URL error body or raw marker

record_contracts.authority_rule: exactly one proven Microsoft artifact is the authoritative readable source; title body and due ownership are user_authoritative
record_contracts.text_rule: no locally persisted draft title body due phrase reminder-time value or generated summary

todo_boundary.permission: Tasks.ReadWrite from disabled PERM-TODO-WRITE-001 only after explicit user enablement and G-ID G-TODO G-PRIV
todo_boundary.read_diagnostic: Tasks.Read remains validation-only and never combines with Tasks.ReadWrite for product use
todo_boundary.reconciliation_baseline: ordinary bounded complete list and task enumeration; To Do delta is not a launch dependency
todo_boundary.collection_selection: explicit user-selected eligible owned list after enumeration; no guessed Tasks or Flagged Email target
unproven_until_G_TODO: built-in and Flagged Email list behavior
marker removal and duplicate marker behavior
prohibited: title body or due identity matching

durability_order: validate current account source loop ownership policy and authorization generations
compute operation_key_hmac without retaining readable intent
commit pending ledger entry under ADR-005 before request
revalidate account authority versions and rollback state
make at most one adapter request
classify response before any retry or cursor advancement
operation_protocol.same_key: same key and canonical intent returns the prior state or result with zero new request; different intent is an operation_key_collision
operation_protocol.known_no_send: only endpoint-independent proof that no request was sent may enter bounded retry with retry_at and attempt_count at most 3
operation_protocol.cursor_rule: pending attempt_started ambiguous reconciling and user_assisted are nonterminal and prevent dependent cursor advancement
operation_protocol.restart_rule: detected-loop intent must be reconstructed from current evidence and policy then match operation_key_hmac; mismatch or unavailable evidence makes zero request
operation_protocol.manual_draft_rule: a pre-request manual draft is never persisted and cannot auto-resume after restart; require re-entry and reconfirmation
operation_protocol.terminal_local_rule: ADR-008 local terminal transition commits independently; remote failure never rolls it back

remote_marker_protocol.support_status: unproven until the selected endpoint field and query contract pass G-TODO or G-CAL
remote_marker_protocol.derivation: base32url of SHA-256 over remote-marker-v1 plus canonical operation_id bytes; operation_id is encrypted approved opaque state and the marker is non-secret
remote_marker_protocol.persisted_verifier: remote_correlation_hmac only; no raw marker is persisted
remote_marker_protocol.request_rule: send the derived marker only through an endpoint-supported contract-tested opaque field; never a title body due URL or link label
remote_marker_protocol.enumeration_rule: ambiguous create first performs bounded complete enumeration of the exact account adapter and collection; incomplete paging is never zero

outcomes.complete_zero: safe bounded same-marker retry only when marker support remains proven and authority is unchanged
outcomes.complete_one: link the single verified marker match
outcomes.complete_many: user-assisted duplicate selection; no automatic linkage or retry
outcomes.incomplete: user-assisted or continue bounded enumeration; never infer zero
outcomes.missing_removed_or_unsupported: user-assisted select abandon or explicit recreate; no automatic retry

remote_marker_protocol.recreate_rule: explicit user confirmation with duplicate warning increments recreate_generation and produces a new operation identity

reminder_time_boundary.rule: transiently recompute from the approved operative due value plus encrypted user reminder_lead_rule at every authorized write
reminder_time_boundary.persistence: no reminder-time value ownership digest or override field is approved; ADR-009 invents none
reminder_time_boundary.direct_edit: independent remote reminder-time edits are not durably modeled; surface fixed review/unmanaged behavior and make zero automatic overwrite pending an approved privacy revision
reminder_time_boundary.intent_commitment: the transient reminder-time digest participates only inside operation_key_hmac

direct_edit_and_conflict.enumeration: re-fetch current artifact before any update and compare exact owned field digests and version
direct_edit_and_conflict.stale_or_changed: stop at reminder conflict; no PATCH until adapter-specific conditional-write behavior is proven
direct_edit_and_conflict.partial_update: patch only the exact service-owned field mask; preserve every user-owned sibling field
direct_edit_and_conflict.completion: To Do completion for detected loops projects completed_needs_evidence and never closes; manual source completion enters explicit confirmation flow
direct_edit_and_conflict.deletion: detected reminder deletion projects missing; manual artifact deletion makes source unavailable; neither fabricates closure

manual_artifact_protocol.precondition: explicit user action current account adapter gate privacy gate and complete nonpersistent draft
manual_artifact_protocol.atomic_success: after proven single success or explicit selection atomically create exactly one user_authored_artifact_ref loop source relation and reminder link
manual_artifact_protocol.failure: cancelled or definitive failed create leaves no durable manual loop or readable draft
manual_artifact_protocol.ambiguous: reconcile only by proven marker; never recreate automatically
manual_artifact_protocol.identity: origin user_authored_microsoft_artifact if and only if exactly one authoritative artifact source is proven
manual_artifact_protocol.locator_binding: source and reminder records derive from the same verified account adapter collection and artifact locator tuple

calendar_boundary.reminder_event: application-owned self-only event with zero attendees no online meeting no response request and no invitation update cancellation mail; all behavior unproven until G-CAL
calendar_boundary.invitation_event: evidence only; OpenLoops never responds changes attendees updates deletes or cancels the invitation event
calendar_boundary.correlation: requires complete ADR-006 identity evidence plus G-MAIL and G-CAL; zero multiple or incomplete results stay unavailable or ambiguous
calendar_boundary.completion: calendar has no completion operation or invented completion state
calendar_boundary.claim: To Do-first preview does not support complete-MVP calendar or invitation claims

review_link_boundary.payload: one random non-secret opaque loop handle only
review_link_boundary.authority: none; resolution requires ADR-010 authenticated per-user account-bound session and current-loop validation
review_link_boundary.activation: unavailable pending ADR-010 and G-ADDIN; unsupported clients omit the link or show fixed safe fallback

prohibited_values: human-readable title body due phrase reminder text or draft
raw Microsoft Graph Office account list artifact event task or URL identifier
raw remote marker request response error or authorization value
free-text conflict correction explanation or note
generic JSON map extension bag open enum unbounded string bytes array or blob
prompt model request response output rationale embedding transcript or vector
privacy_boundary.diagnostics: fixed non-content adapter operation reconciliation failure and count codes only
privacy_boundary.persistence_runtime: disabled; records remain unaccepted until ADR-005 G-STATE G-PRIV and adapter gates pass
